race.description: Greyhounds As Pets (Pbd Data N/P) Stake Pr2 Divisi
race.comment: LET'S ENJOY THIS (1) was well supported last time and ran up to expectations, burning early to score a 2.75 lengths win at this track over 342m in 19.66. Sure to prove hard to beat. PURE GOUT (7) was a (23.33) winner last time out at Mt Gambier from Box 4. Expecting another bold showing. TROPHY DARTS (2) goes very well this course and distance starting 25 times for 10 wins and four minors. Was out of the placings last time (20.11) at this track in a Free For All, finishing fifth and beaten 9 lengths. Can hit the frame with the right run. CARRY ON OLIVE (8) hit the frame latest (22.83) when third at Gawler in a Grade 5. Has already won two times from this draw.
